lcc_original: 塞特生以挪士之後，又活了八百零七年，這期間還生兒養女。
notes: UNV '並且生' → LCC '這期間還生': the verbal root 生 receives <WH03205><WTH8686>; the surrounding 這期間還 is LCC's periphrastic temporal expansion with no Hebrew equivalent, left unannotated.
{<WAH0853>} kept implicit — LCC has no explicit direct-object particle corresponding to Hebrew את.
Double <WH08141> (שָׁנָה) preserved as in UNV: Hebrew attaches 'year' to both the hundreds and the units numeral in the source text.
